one_liner: Smartsheet has a broad REST API with OAuth2 and API tokens plus a vendor-run MCP server, but API and MCP access require a paid Business, Enterprise or Advanced Work Management plan.
auth_notes: 3-legged OAuth 2.0 via Developer Tools registration; bearer access tokens generated in the Smartsheet UI. The MCP server accepts either an API token or OAuth. Regional base URLs differ (US, EU, AU, Gov).
access_notes: The API and MCP docs both state a required plan of Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management. No free tier or trial path appears in the fetched pages (absence only, so not conclusive).
blocker_notes: The builder needs a paid Smartsheet plan (Business or higher) to use the API, generate tokens and register OAuth apps.

evidence.quote: The API authenticates using access tokens (API keys). You can generate access tokens in the Smartsheet UI.
Developer Tools is a Smartsheet user interface for registering client applications that use OAuth to access Smartsheet user resources with the user's consent.
